title: Yeast Single Cell RNA-Seq (yscRNA-seq)
author: Mariona Nadal-Ribelles
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.t29eqh6
materials: When beads are dried, elute dscDNA libraries with 16.5 µL, elution buffer (EB buffer Qiagen) ( 19086 )

In order to load Tn5 with cell-specific adaptors, these need to be annealed as dsDNA cell-specific adaptors. To anneal the adapters mix in a 96 well plate: Mix UMI-TN5-U (100 µM) and UMI-TN5_1 (µM) to 96 in TE 1X to final concentration 50 µM (each), a 1:1 dilution. Primer annealing thermocycler: 95ºC for 3 minutes and gradually cool down to room temperature (0,5 ºC/sec). This plate can be stored at -20ºC for several months and used to lead several rounds of Tn5.

Use the qPCR to calculate library quantification using the template provided by KAPA biosystems or the instructions provided from your manufacturer. We have used KAPA, NEB and homemade systems with similar results.

steps.title: Prepare Yeast Pre-inoculum
steps.instruction: Grow the desired yeast strain pre-inoculum in corresponding media overnight. For exponentially growing cells, ensure the initial culture does not exceed OD660=1.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Sorting
steps.instruction: Dilute cells to OD660=0.05 in corresponding media and allow for at least 2 cell divisions prior to sorting.

steps.title: Prepare Collection Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare 96/384 well plates (break-away plates EK-75118 recommended) containing 5 µL of Absolute Ethanol in each well to fix cells immediately. Alternatively, cells can be sorted directly into 5 µL of cell capturing solution and lysis (keep plates on ice at 4 °C).

steps.title: Final Cell Preparation
steps.instruction: Dilute cells to OD=0.05 in 3 mL of media and vortex vigorously to separate clumps. Propidium iodide (PI) may be added at this stage to check viability.

steps.title: FACS Sorting
steps.instruction: Filter cells using Cell Strainer Tubes and transfer to appropriate sorting tubes for live single cell sorting.

substeps.instruction: Verify plate alignment by sorting a drop into a covered plate to ensure droplets fall inside wells.
Sort live single yeast into each well.
Leave one well (e.g., H12) as a negative control.
Optional: Sort 100 cells into one well (e.g., A1) as a positive control.

steps.title: Cell Fixation and Lysis
steps.instruction: Process the sorted plates to fix and lyse the cells.

substeps.instruction: Cover plates with aluminum seal or temporary plastic lid if not processed immediately.
Quickly spin plates to collect cells at the bottom.
Let EtOH evaporate in a sterile hood for a maximum of 45 minutes.
Add 5 µL of yeast cell lysis solution (or cell capturing solution and lysis).
Spin down and freeze immediately at -80 °C (stable for at least 6 months).

steps.title: Cell Lysis Cycle
steps.instruction: Perform the lysis cycle using fresh or frozen plates before proceeding to cDNA synthesis.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 30 °C for 10 to 30 minutes.
Incubate at 72 °C for 3 minutes.
Incubate at 4 °C for 1 minute.

steps.title: First Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of Reverse Transcription (RT) mix to each well. The RT mix consists of: 5X SuperScript Stand Buffer (1 µL), MgCl2 1M (0.06 µL), Betaine 5M (1.6 µL), UMI_TSO 100uM (0.2 µL), SuperScript II 200 U/ul (0.25 µL), RNase inhibitor (0.125 µL), and water (0.765 µL).

substeps.instruction: Spin down the plate.
Incubate at 42 °C for 90 minutes.
Incubate at 70 °C for 15 minutes.
Cool to 4 °C.

steps.title: Library Quality Check (qPCR)
steps.instruction: Perform a 1:20 dilution of the amplified library to check the percentage of positive libraries using target primers for a housekeeping gene or ERCCs.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction: Sybergreen 2X (2.5 µL), Primer mix (0.125 µL - mix of Fw and Rv 10µM each), H2O (1.375 µL), DNA (1 µL).
Run PCR: 1 cycle (95 °C 10 min); 40 cycles (95 °C 30 sec, 58 °C 30 sec, 72 °C 30 sec); 1 cycle (95 °C 15 sec, 60 °C 15 sec, 95 °C 15 sec for melting curve).
Use primers: TDH3 (Fw: TCGTCAAGTTGGTCTCCTGG, Rv: GGCAACGTGTTCAACCAAGT), ADH1 (Fw: TGGTGCCAAGTGTTGTTCTG, Rv: GGCGAAGAAGTCCAAAGCTT), or ERCC_00130 (Fw: CGGAAAAGTACTGACCAGCG, Rv: TGCCAATGACTTCAGCTGAC).
Identify positive wells (target >50-70%) and rearrange into a new plate for tagmentation.

steps.title: cDNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the cDNA using Ampure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate Ampure XP beads at room temperature for 15 min and vortex.
Add 15 µL Ampure XP beads (1:0.6 ratio) to each sample; do not exceed 1:1 ratio.
Mix by pipetting 10 times and transfer to a 96-well plate on a magnetic stand.
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Place on magnet for 5 min until solution is clear; remove liquid.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol; incubate 30 sec per wash.
Dry beads at room temperature for 5 min (until small cracks appear); cover plate to prevent contamination.
Remove from magnet and resuspend by pipetting 3 times.
Place on magnet for 2 min until clear.
Recover 15 µL of supernatant (SPN) and transfer to a new plate. Store at -20 °C if needed.

steps.title: Purification Validation
steps.instruction: Run 1 µL of purified dscDNA libraries on a High Sensitivity DNA ChIP (2100 Bioanalyzer) to check size and concentration. Use qPCR validation with housekeeping genes and include the negative control.

steps.title: Tagmentation Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the Tn5-loaded mix. Aliquot 8.75 µL of the mix (excluding adapters) into a new 96-well plate, then add 1.25 µL of each adapter to each well.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour.
Store at -20 °C if not used immediately (stable for 1-2 weeks). Do not store on ice at 4 °C.

steps.title: Tagmentation Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform tagmentation on the prepared libraries.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 55 °C for 5 min.
Incubate at 85 °C for 3 min to inactivate Tn5.
Cool to 4 °C.

steps.title: Streptavidin Bead Capture
steps.instruction: Capture the tagmented DNA using MyOne Streptavidin beads.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 1:20 dilution of MyOne Streptavidin (1 µL beads/sample) in 2XBWT Buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH7.5, 1mM EDTA, 2M NaCl, 0.02% Tween-20).
Wash beads twice with 2XBWT buffer and resuspend in 20X the original bead volume with 2XBWT.
Add 20 µL beads to each well and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Pool all samples into a single 1.5 or 2 mL collecting tube.
Place tube in magnetic rack until the solution is clear.

steps.title: Bead Washing and Elution
steps.instruction: Wash and elute the captured DNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Wash once with 100 µL TNT Buffer (20 mM Tris pH 7.5, 50 mM NaCl, 0.02% Tween).
Wash once with 100 µL Qiaquick PB; discard SPN.
Wash three times with 100 µL TNT buffer; discard SPN.
Resuspend beads in the specified mix and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour (mix every few minutes: 2 min still, 30 sec at 1000 rpm).
Wash beads three times with 100 µL TNT.
Resuspend in 30 µL Nuclease-free water.
Incubate for 10 min at 70 °C with 850 rpm mixing.
Immediately bind to magnet and collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Final Library Purification
steps.instruction: Perform a final cleanup of the sscDNA library using Ampure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 54 µL of room temperature Ampure XP beads to the 30 µL sscDNA library.
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Bind to magnet for 1 min and discard supernatant.
Wash once with 200 µL fresh 80% ethanol for 20-30 sec while on the magnet.
Dry beads for up to 2 min.
Resuspend in 30 µL Qiagen EB buffer and incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Bind to magnet for 1 min and transfer SPN to a new tube.

steps.title: Library Quantification and Sizing
steps.instruction: Quantify and size the final library.

substeps.instruction: Set up KAPA quantification with 1:100 and 1:1000 dilutions of eluted cDNA (or use qPCR with P5-P7 primers and PhiX standards).
Set up a separate PCR for Bioanalyzer sizing.
Run the sizing PCR for 11 cycles.
Run 1 µL on a High sensitivity DNA CHIP to determine average library size.

steps.title: Sequencing
steps.instruction: Sequence the library on a HiSeq 2000 High output system.

substeps.instruction: Use C1-P1-PCR-2 as the Read 1 primer and UMI-TN5-U as the Index read primer.
For HiSeq rapid runs, use LNA primers (spike in at 0.5 uM). Index 1 primer in HP8 (pos 17), Read 1 primer in HP9 (pos 16).
LNA Primers: UMI_PCR_read1 (+GAATGA+TACGGCG+ACCA +CCGA+T), Index1 (CTGT+CT+CTT+ATA+CA +CA+TCTGA+CG+C).
Load 8-14 pmol of each library per lane (no denaturing required as DNA is single-stranded).
